import json,zipfile,io,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('evaluation/scripts').resolve()))
from evaluate_external_kitti_odometry import load_reference_csv
r=Path('experiments/results/imu_dr_readme_and_retrieval')
p=json.loads((r/'matcher_protocol.json').read_text())
csv=load_reference_csv(Path('experiments/reference_data/kitti_seq_00_full_gt.csv'))
o=Path('/tmp/localization-zoo-inten-gt-audit-20261022/official')
with zipfile.ZipFile(o/'data_odometry_poses.zip') as z: raw=np.loadtxt(io.BytesIO(z.read('dataset/poses/00.txt')))
with zipfile.ZipFile(o/'data_odometry_calib.zip') as z: lines=z.read('dataset/sequences/00/calib.txt').decode().splitlines()
tr=np.eye(4);tr[:3]=np.array(list(map(float,next(x for x in lines if x.startswith('Tr:')).split()[1:]))).reshape(3,4)
rows=[]
for c in p['cases']:
 i,j=c['source_frame'],c['target_frame']
 frames=[]
 for k in (i,j):
  x=np.eye(4);x[:3]=raw[k].reshape(3,4);frames.append(x@tr)
 canonical=np.linalg.solve(frames[1],frames[0]);current=np.linalg.solve(csv[j],csv[i])
 rows.append({'case':c['id'],'max_matrix_difference':float(np.max(np.abs(canonical-current))),'translation_difference_m':float(np.linalg.norm(canonical[:3,3]-current[:3,3])),'source_world_translation_difference_m':float(np.linalg.norm(frames[0][:3,3]-csv[i][:3,3])),'target_world_translation_difference_m':float(np.linalg.norm(frames[1][:3,3]-csv[j][:3,3])),'source_rotation_nonorthogonality':float(np.max(np.abs(frames[0][:3,:3].T@frames[0][:3,:3]-np.eye(3)))),'target_rotation_nonorthogonality':float(np.max(np.abs(frames[1][:3,:3].T@frames[1][:3,:3]-np.eye(3))))})
out={'diagnostic_only':True,'original_frame_gate_tolerance':1e-4,'rows':rows}
(r/'frame_difference_diagnostic.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
